# VKeyHit

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Keyboard](BlitzBasic-Keyboard)

</div>


```blitzbasic
VKeyHit:Int32 scancode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scancode` | In | Int32 | required | The SDL scancode of the key, 1 to 511. |

**Returns:** How many times the key was pressed since the last call.

## Description

Counts how often a key was pressed since the last time this asked about that same key, asking for the key by its SDL scancode instead of the DirectInput code that [KeyHit](KeyHit) takes. The count starts again from zero on every call. See Scan Codes for the table.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
While Not KeyHit(1)
	Cls
	Text 10, 10, "Press F16 (SDL scancode 107), Escape ends"
	If VKeyHit(107) Then Text 10, 30, "F16"
	Flip
Wend
```
